main_text.p: culo subjiceret; idque citra necessitatem: Deum tentet, remedium quoddam extraordinarium probandæ veritatis adhibendo, in quo etiam ipse, nisi miraculosum Dei auxilium speret, licet innocens, tam quàm adversarius perire possset. Denique de Dei providentiâ, & auxilio desperet, quasi non ille huic malo remedium adferre valeat, adeoque efficere, ut tandem innocentia probi hominis fiat conspicua, ad instar lucis meridianæ.
Multò minùs parti innocenti permissum erit, acceptare duellum, si aliter forte jacturam aliquam honoris, aut bonorum in notabili quantitate evadere nequeat. Ratio 1.est.[?]

page.notes: Running head is printed with spaced letters ("V o ë t") and is given as "P. VOET". The word after "Ratio" is hard to read; it may be "1." or "r.", so it is marked [?]. Small marks in the margins are specks, not text. The word "necessitatem" is printed as "cessitatem" at the line break, which is kept as the printer's abbreviation of the word, with the first part of the word on the previous line.
